cohort: 80 SGA fetuses (defined by estimated fetal and birth weights < 10th centile) delivered > 34 weeks' gestation and 80 normally grown age-matched control fetuses
finding: Cardiovascular changes are present prenatally in SGA fetuses and persist at 6 months of age, suggesting that prenatal cardiovascular remodeling may be a mechanism for increased cardiovascular risk later in life, independent of Doppler abnormalities.
